summary: Benewah County, Idaho St. Joe NF lookout: a 30-foot pole platform with cabin built 1940, abandoned 1955; the cabin is described as in ruins; hike-in.

facts.design: 30-foot pole platform with cabin living quarters
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1955; firelookout.com says the cabin is in ruins and still there; no source says whether the pole platform still stands

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as a hike-in; no current access details found

events.note: Pole platform with cabin living quarters; Forest Lookouts gives it as a 30-foot pole platform
Abandoned; firelookout.com says the cabin is in ruins and still there

evidence.supports: pole platform with cabin living quarters built in 1940
evidence.quote: This pole platform, along with cabin living quarters, were built in 1940.

evidence.supports: cabin in ruins and still there
pages describe the cabin remains but not whether the platform stands

notes_for_editor: The three pages agree on the 1940 build and 1955 abandonment; Forest Lookouts attributes its dates to Kresek, so they may share one origin. The record's height_m 9.1 matches the 30-foot figure on Forest Lookouts (30 ft is about 9.14 m). The record kind 'tower' is kept; the sources call it a pole platform. The record status 'gone' understates the cabin ruins firelookout.com says remain; consider a status that reflects ruins if the schema allows it. The one WebSearch returned mostly Castle Butte, a different lookout on the Nez Perce-Clearwater, and was not used. Idaho Fire Lookouts photos are credited to the Fire Lookout Museum and Luke Channer with no licence stated; no new photos added. The record's existing photo is from idahofirelookouts.com.
